item.title: Jennifer Lopez & Brett Goldstein Address Offscreen Romance Rumors: ‘You Know What Everyone Is Saying…’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dish out the latest celebrity news. Today, we're talking about Jennifer Lopez and the rumors surrounding her love life.
Recently, JLo sat down with the Today show, alongside her co-star Brett Goldstein, to promote their new rom-com Office Romance. But the conversation took a turn when they were asked about their relationship off-camera.
[Clip of Lopez's interview plays in the background]
Host: It all started when Lopez confessed to Andy Cohen on Watch What Happens Live that Goldstein was the best kisser she's ever had. Savannah Guthrie brought up the topic, asking if there was any truth to the rumors that they're dating in real life.
Lopez quickly brushed it off, saying that every time she's seen with someone, people assume they're dating. Goldstein chimed in, joking that if you stand near Lopez, you'll probably be linked to her romantically.
[Clip of Lopez and Goldstein's reaction plays]
Host: Guthrie pressed for a straight answer, but Lopez maintained that she's not dating Goldstein. In fact, she said that she's often linked to people she's working with or standing near, citing Kevin Costner as an example.
[Clip of Lopez saying "Not dating" plays]
Host: So, it seems like the rumors can be put to rest. But in other news, Lopez has been making waves on the Billboard charts with her hit song "On the Floor", which recently made a comeback thanks to a scene from the Prime Video series Off Campus.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one.
